svg.title: Rectangle Ultra snapping a window with keyboard shortcuts
svg.desc: A window on a Mac desktop snaps to the left half with Control Option Left, the right half with Control Option Right, the top-right corner with Control Option I, maximizes with Control Option Return, then restores with Control Option Delete. The shortcut is shown as key caps while it is pressed.
